verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਬੰਝ ਬਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: haumai abhimaan asathaan taj ba(n)jh ban charan kamal gur sa(n)paT samaae hai ||

en.bdb: The black bee like mind of a Guru-oriented person who is attached with the congregation of saintly persons, forsakes pride and ego which is like a jungle of bamboos. He leaves attachment and infatuations. Enamoured by the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, he remains engrossed in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਨਹਦ ਗੁੰਜਤ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹੂ ਸਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: at hee anoop roop herat hiraane dhirag anahadh gu(n)jat sravan hoo siraae hai ||

en.bdb: Seeing the most beautiful form of the True Guru, his eyes are amazed. Listening to the pleasing and enchanting notes of the words of Guru, his ears feel calm and tranquil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਚਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਮਹਿਕਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rasanaa bisam at madh makara(n)dh ras naasikaa chakit hee subaas mahikaae hai ||

en.bdb: Relishing the sweet elixir-like dust of the feet of the True Guru, the tongue enjoys strange bliss and pleasure. The nostrils are amazed by the sweet smell of that dust of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਪੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਪੁਨਿ ਅਨਤ ਨਾ ਧਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੫॥
verses.translit_en: komalataa seetalataa pa(n)g saraba(n)g bhe man madhukar pun anat naa dhaae hai ||335||

en.bdb: Experiencing the calmness and tenderness of the sweet smell of the holy feet of the True Guru, all limbs of the body become stable. The black bee like mind then does not wander anywhere else and remains attached with lotus-like feet. (335)
